released under CC0 1.0 Universal (public domain dedication). They may be used
for any purpose, commercial or not, with no attribution required.

  https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

Attribution is given here anyway, because the people who made them deserve it.

  concrete_{diff,nor,arm}.jpg   from "concrete_wall_008"
  drywall_{diff,nor,arm}.jpg    from "plastered_wall"
  floor_{diff,nor,arm}.jpg      from "wood_floor"
  wood_{diff,nor,arm}.jpg       from "black_walnut_veneer_01"
  fabric_{diff,nor,arm}.jpg     from "cotton_jersey"
  tile_{diff,nor,arm}.jpg       from "floor_tiles_02"

The `arm` maps are Poly Haven's packed ones: ambient occlusion in the red
channel, roughness in green, metalness in blue. One file does the work of
three, and since they carry numbers rather than a picture they are cut to 768
px and quality 78 — six of them together weigh less than one colour map.

Colour and normal maps are 1K at quality 88. Eighteen maps in 1.9 MB.
